type: Focused follow-up QA after complete initial localization review

scans.numberDisposition: All were legitimate written-number, time-format, ordinal, pint or currency representations. No quantity or price correction required.
scans.identicalEnglishDisposition: German Medium and three DIANE: Oh interjections are intentional.
scans.englishFragmentDisposition: Japanese keyboard keys, work titles, BMW, RAC, Webshots and the amount template are intentional; no German English-prose leftovers found.

changes.english: She sits there for a few seconds but nothing happens. Diane pushes the hem of her skirt forwards modestly, but it doesn’t cover much. After a while she gives a little embarrassed laugh.
changes.before: 数秒座っているが、何も起こらない。慎み深くスカートの裾を前へ押し出すが、あまり隠れない。しばらくして、恥ずかしそうに小さく笑う。

changes.reason: Use the already-reviewed parallel wording: 裾 covers both a skirt and the lower part of the Saturday dress; 少しでも隠そうと describes the modest action naturally.

changes.english: She realises you are watching, blushes slightly and pushes the hem of her skirt further down. She is leaning forward, her hands on her knees. You cannot see the stream anymore, but the sound of her pee now at full force is marvellous. After a while it lessens and she murmurs, ‘Almost finished,’ but then there is a bit more before it trickles into silence. It must have lasted a full minute. She pulls off a piece of toilet tissue, reaches down and wipes herself.
changes.before: 見られていると気づいた彼女は少し赤くなり、スカートの裾をさらに下げる。両手を膝に置き、前かがみになっている。尿の流れはもう見えないが、今や勢いを増した水音が素晴らしい。しばらくすると弱まり、「もう少しで終わる」とつぶやく。それからもう少し出て、最後は細い流れとなり、静かになる。丸一分は続いたはずだ。彼女はトイレットペーパーを切り取り、手を下へ伸ばして拭く。
changes.after: 見られていると気づいた彼女は少し赤くなり、裾をさらに下げる。両手を膝に置き、前かがみになっている。尿の流れはもう見えないが、今や勢いを増した水音が素晴らしい。しばらくすると弱まり、「もう少しで終わる」とつぶやく。それからもう少し出て、最後は細い流れとなり、静かになる。丸一分は続いたはずだ。彼女はトイレットペーパーを切り取り、手を下へ伸ばして拭く。
changes.reason: The shared scene also accepts the Saturday dress. Refer to its hem without implying a separate skirt.

changes.english: Diane really needed to go, so – even with you standing there gawping at her – she starts peeing almost as soon as she sits on the loo. She pushes the hem of her skirt forward to protect some modesty, but it doesn’t conceal much.

changes.english: She goes up to a tourist information board, stands there a moment while the drunks pass. She is facing away from you, as if pretending to read the board. The drunks disappear into the distance and Diane looks to see if they have gone, but doesn’t move. She seems to be fiddling with her skirt, is bent slightly forward and then –
